title: Add browser smoke suite for nodes and tunnels
description: Exercise representative node creation/test, tunnel creation/validation/deploy/action, status, logs/events, and error states in a disposable browser fixture.
acceptanceCriteria: Node and tunnel forms validate required fields and show accessible errors
A disposable tunnel can be created, deployed, started/stopped or actioned, and its state/logs are displayed without false success
Invalid method/config and connectivity failures show actionable sanitized feedback
No page/console errors occur during the representative flow

steps.details: Write a headless/manual browser flow for node and tunnel happy/error paths and run it to capture current behavior.
Use a temporary database and controlled test endpoints/mocks only where a real remote node is unavailable; mark mocked evidence clearly.
Correct only evidence-backed state, validation, action, and error-display gaps without changing the public API shape.
Run the flow in en/fa, capture sanitized evidence, and run typecheck/lint/custom tests.

technicalNotes: Do not point browser tests at real remote nodes or use real tunnel credentials.
